title: Test 1 · Exam Practice · Reading Part 1
instructions: Questions 1–5. Read each text and choose the correct answer, A, B or C.

questions.source:
Message from Mum to Anton:
“Anton, When you see your sister at the basketball match later, can you make sure she remembers that Dad’s coming to fetch her instead of me? I’ve tried ringing, but her phone’s off. Thanks, Mum”
questions.ask: What does Mum want Anton to do?

options.A: Anton has to check his sister knows about the arrangements for getting home.
options.B: Anton should remind his sister to switch her phone back on.
options.C: Anton needs to ask his sister if she’s taking part in a sports event later.

questions.explanationVi: Mẹ muốn Anton chắc chắn em gái biết bố sẽ đến đón thay vì mẹ. Cụm “make sure she remembers” và “Dad’s coming to fetch her instead of me” khớp với A.

questions.source:
Film advertisement:
“From the famous novel by Ben Whitham: a film about a bear’s adventures. Fun for all the family!”

options.A: about a family of wild animals.
options.B: not suitable for people under a certain age.
options.C: based on a popular fiction book.

questions.explanationVi: Quảng cáo nói bộ phim được chuyển thể từ một tiểu thuyết nổi tiếng (“from the famous novel”). Vì vậy chọn C. Không có thông tin rằng phim kể về một gia đình động vật.

questions.source:
New Message
From: Mrs Hoskins
To: All students
“Before the end of term, please return all books you have borrowed from the library, or see someone at the desk if you want to have them for the summer holiday.”

options.A: You must take back all the library books you’ve got before the summer holiday.
options.B: If there are library books you want, borrow them before the end of term.
options.C: To keep any library books for holiday reading, ask staff at the desk.

questions.explanationVi: Muốn giữ sách trong kỳ nghỉ, học sinh cần hỏi nhân viên tại quầy (“see someone at the desk”). A sai vì không nhất thiết phải trả sách nếu đã xin phép giữ lại.

questions.source:
Message from Nicola to Tina:
“Tina, When you come round tonight, can you bring that earring you found outside school the other day? I think I know who it belongs to, so I’ll return it. Thanks, Nicola”
questions.ask: What is Nicola asking Tina to do?

options.A: Nicola is telling Tina to return something she was lent recently.
options.B: Nicola is hoping she can give a lost item back to its owner.
options.C: Nicola is asking for help to find a lost earring belonging to her.

questions.explanationVi: Tina đã nhặt được khuyên tai. Nicola nghĩ mình biết chủ nhân nên muốn trả lại: “I know who it belongs to, so I’ll return it”. Đáp án B.

questions.source:
BIKES FOR HIRE
Adult cycles always available
Children’s cycles — book in advance
8 a.m. – 9 p.m.
Only £20 per day
questions.ask: What do customers need to know?

options.A: Families may not find suitable bikes for everyone unless they’ve reserved them.
options.B: You can always find a range of bikes for hire here.
options.C: Bikes aren’t available for customers’ use in the evenings.

questions.explanationVi: Xe trẻ em cần đặt trước (“book in advance”), dù xe người lớn luôn có. Gia đình có thể không có đủ loại xe nếu không đặt trước. Quầy hoạt động đến 9 giờ tối nên C sai.
